description.en: Starts a soccer match/challenge on a given map with a given battle script ID, with an options table (or a legacy boolean) controlling the match setup.
ID of the match map, e.g. "mf01b01".
ID of the battle/challenge script to run, e.g. "btl0302".
Match options table, or a boolean for simple cases.
True once the call has taken effect; null if the call was invalid (e.g. too few arguments, or required engine/script state not ready).

example.code:
// Start a scripted soccer challenge
CMND_SOCCER_BATTLE("mf01b01", "btl0302", true);
